data.basis: Each team's best trade both lineups gain by, yours first. The other team decides. A player we rank first at his position goes only for 1.0 a week or more, or to fill a spot.
data.check_basis: The scoreboard is each lineup before and after the trade.
data.basis_note: Our stats omit two-point, missed kick, fumble recovery and safety.

trades.drop_reason: Williams starts at WR3 for you this week. After the trade Tucker starts at Flex 1 and your lineup stays full.

moves.reason: Sleeper does not take trade proposals from here, so we copy the trade for you to propose there.

data.per_game_basis: A game is our order's points a game.
data.gain_basis: points over replacement in each lineup, weeks 6 to 17
data.rest_of_season_basis: Rest of season is what the players a side gets score over the best free agent at their position, less the same for those it gives and drops, weeks 6 to 17. We list a trade only when neither side falls by more than 12.0.
data.basis_note_list: two-point, missed kick, fumble recovery and safety
